required_abstract_passages: She received adjuvant ipilimumab and nivolumab for 3 cycles complicated by grade 3 transaminitis
The patient remains on single agent nivolumab without evidence of detectable disease almost 18 months after initial diagnosis.
42923311.finding: Case report. Grade 3 transaminitis complicated a three-cycle course of ipilimumab plus nivolumab. No disease was detectable almost 18 months after diagnosis, during nivolumab monotherapy.

required_abstract_passages: Platelet count showed a U-shaped association with overall survival.
Similar patterns were observed in the validation and cancer-specific cohorts.
42945901.finding: The melanoma analysis included 377 patients. The authors describe a similar U-shaped association between platelet count and OS in the cancer-specific cohorts. The abstract gives no melanoma-specific HR.
